name: bat-remover
description: Durable, high-speed GitHub malware scanning and remediation platform.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.docker:up: docker compose pull api && docker compose up -d
scripts.docker:build: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -f apps/api/Dockerfile -t imranwebstudio/bat-remover-api:latest -t imranwebstudio/bat-remover-api:0.1.0 --push .
